<There are multiple swaths of fabric that look like torn pieces of clothing, written with charcoal, sealed in the bottle with a cork stopper.>

Help! Our ship, Sethralis's Scale, has run aground.  We are on an island east of Zul'Aman. Send help and you can have the cargo we saved.

- Captain Lenta

<The next scrap of cloth is from a fine jacket.>

The bottle came back. Again. I've thrown it out to see on the tide. This makes no sense. If you find this, tell a tortollan sailor. They will know who I am. We still have plenty of cargo to reward you if you come and rescue us.

- Captain Lenta

<This scrap seems to be leather from a backpack.>

This bottle won't stop returning. This island is haunted and infested with snakes. We would still like to be rescued, but I understand if you stay far away from here. All we have found are wrecks of Zandalari ships. I should never have purchased a Zandalari ship. Whatever has cursed this island does not like the Zandalari. Can't it see I'm a tortollan? I hope this bottle floats away this time.
 
- Captain Lenta

<The final scrap was written on a sun-bleached hat.>

Captain Lenta was bitten by a snake. Don't come here. This island is a cage.
- Swabby Wuck
